About

My path toward data analysis

How I think about data, where I've applied it, and the learning that got me here.

I'm Jayanth Kancharla, a B.Tech graduate in Computer Science and Engineering with a specialization in Data Science. My goal is to build a career as a Data Analyst, finding the insights in data that help a team make better decisions.

Right now, I'm a Digital Marketing Executive at Emblix Solutions, where much of my work is analytical: monitoring campaign performance, social media metrics and audience data, then using what the data shows to decide the next steps. Before that, I completed internships as a Project Coordinator / Business Analyst at iGRAND IT and in QA testing at Keyutech, so I'm as comfortable discussing a web build as a dataset.

I'm actively working toward a dedicated Data Analyst role and am open to opportunities where I can put my data science background to direct use.
